clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 11969, whose subject line describes the administration of the Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977. Section 1 delegates to the Chairman of the Federal Power Commission all of the President’s authority under the Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977 except the authority to declare and terminate a natural gas emergency under section 3 of that Act. Executive Order 12038 (signed 1978-02-03, effective as of 1977-10-01 under its section 6) amended section 1 by deleting its second sentence and by substituting the Secretary of Energy for the Chairman of the Federal Power Commission; before: the authority was delegated to the Chairman and the second sentence said the delegation was not to the Commission as a collective body; after: the authority is delegated to the Secretary of Energy and that sentence is gone. The clause continues, amended, under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (strike-and-insert); the substance of the delegatee changed. No earlier express end was found.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 11969 (42 FR 6791, Federal Register of February 4, 1977; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Administration of the Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977 and signed February 2, 1977. It delegates the President’s authority under the Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977 to the Chairman of the Federal Power Commission. Inventory: five numbered sections, confirmed against the full held text, each recorded as one clause. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 11969, whose subject line describes the administration of the Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977. Executive Order 12038 of February 3, 1978, effective as of October 1, 1977 under its own section 6, amended sections 1 to 5 as recorded in each clause; it is an amendment and a later event, not an end. The statute text (Public Law 95-2) is not held; any expiry of that Act is an unnamed instrument and a disclosed candidate only (owner ruling 2026-10-21, unnamed instruments).  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found citations of this number outside its own printings only in the printings of EO 12038. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
